title: Creamy Garlic Butter Pasta
description: Silky pasta tossed in garlic butter, parmesan and herbs for the kind of dinner that feels homemade in every bite.
author: HomeCooked Kitchen
instructions: Cook pasta until just al dente and reserve a little pasta water.
Sauté garlic gently in butter until fragrant.
Add pasta, parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy.
Finish with parsley, black pepper and extra parmesan.

title: Honey Lemon Roast Chicken
description: Juicy roast chicken glazed with honey, lemon and herbs, with crisp golden skin and a bright finish.
author: Maya's Kitchen
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C and pat the chicken dry.
Mix honey, lemon juice, garlic, thyme and olive oil.
Coat chicken and roast until deeply golden and cooked through.
Rest for 8 minutes before serving with lemon wedges.

title: Berry Breakfast Pancakes
description: Fluffy weekend pancakes layered with fresh berries, yogurt and a little maple syrup.
author: Nora
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
Add egg and milk, mixing only until combined.
Cook small rounds on a lightly buttered pan until golden on both sides.
Stack with yogurt and berries, then drizzle with maple syrup.

title: Chocolate Olive Oil Cake
description: A deeply chocolatey, tender cake with olive oil and a soft crumb that gets better the next day.
author: HomeCooked Kitchen
instructions: Heat oven to 175°C and line a cake tin.
Whisk eggs, sugar, olive oil and milk until smooth.
Fold in the dry ingredients without overmixing.
Bake until the center is just set. Cool before slicing.

title: Creamy Tomato Soup
description: A cozy bowl of roasted tomato soup finished with cream, basil and a warm grilled cheese on the side.
author: Sam's Table
instructions: Roast tomatoes, onion and garlic until caramelized.
Transfer to a pot with stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir through cream.
Season and serve with basil and crusty bread.

title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
description: Golden, crunchy potatoes with fluffy centers, garlic oil and fresh herbs.
author: The Sunday Table
instructions: Boil potatoes until fork tender, then drain well.
Place on a tray and gently smash each potato.
Brush with garlic oil and roast until crisp and golden.
Finish with rosemary, sea salt and pepper.
